item.title: NIF Probe, Immigration Misconduct, Elder Care Bill
item.ns0:title: NIF Probe, Immigration Misconduct, Elder Care Bill
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the Davis administration doubles down in Parliament over its controversial handling of the National Investment Fund as the Opposition demands accountability and threatens legal action. Meanwhile, the Public Accounts Committee releases a scathing report exposing major financial oversight failures surrounding the 2023 Carifta Games, while senior immigration officials prepare for expanded powers to crack down on staff misconduct. Plus, Parliament tables a landmark bill establishing new legal protections for vulnerable seniors, alongside major updates on University of The Bahamas campus repairs and Grand Bahama community concerns. Tune in to get fully caught up on these stories, your local weather forecast, and the latest in sports.
